title: Cognitive biases
learning_outcomes: Explain confirmation bias in the context of cognitive biases.
Compare and distinguish anchoring and availability in the context of cognitive biases.
Apply counterexamples in the context of cognitive biases.
Evaluate and justify decisions about decision journals in the context of cognitive biases.

lessons.title: Confirmation bias
lessons.outcome: Explain confirmation bias in the context of cognitive biases.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving confirmation bias; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to bias audit.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain confirmation bias from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of confirmation bias; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Anchoring and availability
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish anchoring and availability in the context of cognitive biases.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving anchoring and availability; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to bias audit.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain anchoring and availability from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of anchoring and availability; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Counterexamples
lessons.outcome: Apply counterexamples in the context of cognitive biases.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving counterexamples; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to bias audit.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain counterexamples from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of counterexamples; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Decision journals
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about decision journals in the context of cognitive biases.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving decision journals; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to bias audit.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain decision journals from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of decision journals; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of confirmation bias; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of anchoring and availability; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of counterexamples; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of decision journals; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Education, statistics or philosophy specialist as relevant.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
